mapper.select: SELECT character_id, image_enabled, default_mode, allowed_modes_json, reference_source_mode, reference_images_enabled, negative_prompt, updated_at FROM app_character_image_policy WHERE character_id = #{characterId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_character_image_policy ( character_id, image_enabled, default_mode, allowed_modes_json, reference_source_mode, reference_images_enabled, negative_prompt ) VALUES ( #{characterId}, #{imageEnabled}, #{defaultMode}, #{allowedModesJson}, #{referenceSourceMode}, #{referenceImagesEnabled}, #{negativePrompt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE image_enabled = VALUES(image_enabled), default_mode = VALUES(default_mode), allowed_modes_json = VALUES(allowed_modes_json), reference_source_mode = VALUES(reference_source_mode), reference_images_enabled = VALUES(reference_images_enabled), negative_prompt = VALUES(negative_prompt), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_character c WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(c.id AS CHAR) = #{keyword})
